# PeptShop frontend presentation

> This repository owns presentation components for a research-compound marketplace interface.

## Scope

The frontend includes layouts for:

- Catalog and product comparison
- Vendor directory and profiles
- Public certificate-of-analysis presentation
- Cart and checkout
- Synthetic order lookup and status views
- Informational and authentication pages

All records bundled with this repository are synthetic presentation fixtures. Names, prices,
ratings, orders, certificates, dates, and operational states are illustrative and must not be
described as production marketplace facts.

## Integration boundary

The private application supplies reviewed view models and fixed callbacks. This repository does
not contain database access, credentials, payment integrations, customer records, private
algorithms, internal economics, incentive terms, or production order logic.

The protected production QA lane is documented in the repository README. It accepts only reserved
synthetic values and keeps fake orders isolated from customer, payment, inventory, notification,
and fulfillment systems.
